title.narrative: Reducing the Burden of Tuberculosis in Pakistan by Improving Access to Quality Directly Observed Treatment, Short Course (DOTS) and Multi-Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (MDR-TB) Care Services - Pakistan (01-Jul-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Pakistan, Tuberculosis, National TB Control Programme Pakistan (NTP)This program has the following goals: Contribute to achieving the goal of the national strategy to control TB in Pakistan which is to reduce by 50% the prevalence of TB by 2025 in comparison to 2011.. Contribute towards decreasing the prevalence, by at least 5% per year from 2018 onwards, the prevalence of MDR-TB among TB patients who have never received any TB treament.. The objectives of this program are: To enhance MDR-TB enrollment from 18% of estimated cases in 2013-14 to 23% of estimated by 2017. To increase TB case notification (all forms) from 61% of estimated incident cases in 2013-14 to 71% of estimated incident cases by 2017 while maintaining treatment success rate at 91%. To increase the number of TB patients who are screened for HIV infection from 3% in 2013-14 to 10% by 2017.
